construccion-y-reformas.title: Construction and Renovations
construccion-y-reformas.subtitle: We transform your spaces, from scratch or renovating the existing.
construccion-y-reformas.shortDescription: New construction, renovations, and extensions for all types of buildings.
construccion-y-reformas.description: We specialize in executing new constructions, comprehensive renovations, and extensions. Our team of professionals manages each project with the utmost dedication to ensure results that exceed your expectations, paying attention to every detail from the foundation to the final finishes.
features: Comprehensive management of new construction projects.
Complete renovations of homes and commercial premises.
Extensions and redistribution of spaces.
Advice on materials and construction solutions.

gestion-integral-obra-nueva.title: Comprehensive New Build Management
gestion-integral-obra-nueva.description: We coordinate and execute your building project from earthworks to key handover. Total control of deadlines and costs.
gestion-integral-obra-nueva.answer: Building a new home in Mallorca costs between €1,400 and €2,200 per built m², depending on finishes, site access and structural complexity. That covers construction, site management and permits, but not the land. A 200 m² villa typically runs €280,000 to €440,000.

reformas-integrales-viviendas-locales.title: Comprehensive Home & Commercial Renovations
reformas-integrales-viviendas-locales.description: Complete renovation of interior and exterior spaces, adapting your property to modern needs of functionality and style.
reformas-integrales-viviendas-locales.answer: A full home renovation in Mallorca costs between €600 and €1,100 per m², depending on finish level and the starting condition. It covers demolition, new plumbing and electrics, tiling, flooring, joinery and painting. A 90 m² property usually lands between €54,000 and €99,000.

ampliaciones-redistribucion.title: Extensions & Redistribution
ampliaciones-redistribucion.description: We maximize your property's potential by adding square meters or reconfiguring the layout for more open and luminous spaces.
ampliaciones-redistribucion.answer: Extending a property in Mallorca costs €900 to €1,600 per m² of new floor area. The price depends on whether foundations need reinforcing, the roof type and planning permission. Interior reconfiguration without adding area starts at €350 per m² affected.

asesoramiento-materiales-construccion.title: Materials Consultancy
asesoramiento-materiales-construccion.description: Expert advice for choosing sustainable, durable materials that aesthetically align with your architectural vision.
asesoramiento-materiales-construccion.answer: Materials advice is free when you contract the works with us. It includes supplier visits, a technical comparison of alternatives and physical samples. As a standalone consultancy service it starts at €450 for a full-home project.

piscinas.title: Pool Construction
piscinas.subtitle: The oasis you've always dreamed of, in your own home.
piscinas.shortDescription: Design, construction, and maintenance of swimming pools for you to enjoy the summer.
piscinas.description: We design and build custom-made swimming pools, adapted to your land and your dreams. We use the most advanced techniques and top-quality materials to create unique leisure and relaxation spaces for you and your family.
features: Custom pool design.
Construction with shotcrete (gunite).
Installation of saline chlorination and heating systems.
Maintenance and repair service.

diseno-personalizado.title: Custom Pool Design
diseno-personalizado.description: We create unique pools that perfectly integrate with your home's architecture and landscape. Free forms, infinity pools, and signature designs.
diseno-personalizado.answer: A bespoke pool design in Mallorca costs €2,500 to €6,000 and includes a topographic survey, volumetric proposal, renders and the technical documentation for planning permission. The fee is deducted from the construction quote if we build the pool.

construccion-gunitado.title: Shotcrete Construction
construccion-gunitado.description: We use the shotcrete technique to ensure monolithic, totally watertight, and maximum durability vessels.
construccion-gunitado.answer: An 8x4 m gunite concrete pool in Mallorca costs €22,000 to €45,000 turnkey. That covers excavation, the sprayed concrete shell, waterproofing, finish, filtration and coping. Free-form shapes, infinity edges or difficult site access push the price up.

sistemas-cloracion-salina.title: Saline Chlorination & Heating
sistemas-cloracion-salina.description: Enjoy healthier and crystal-clear water with our saline electrolysis systems. Extend the swimming season with efficient heat pumps.
sistemas-cloracion-salina.answer: Salt chlorination in Mallorca costs €1,800 to €4,500 depending on pool volume, including cell, control unit and commissioning. A heat pump to warm the water adds €3,500 to €8,000 and extends the swimming season by roughly four months.

mantenimiento-reparacion.title: Maintenance & Repair Service
mantenimiento-reparacion.description: We take care of tuning, cleaning, grouting, and leak repair so your pool is always impeccable.
mantenimiento-reparacion.answer: Maintaining a private pool in Mallorca costs €120 to €280 a month depending on size and visit frequency. It covers pH and chlorine control, floor and waterline cleaning, filter backwashing and equipment checks. Seasonal opening is billed separately.

reformas-de-interiores.title: Interior Renovations
reformas-de-interiores.subtitle: Renew the heart of your home: functional and designer bathrooms and kitchens.
reformas-de-interiores.shortDescription: Specialists in bathroom and kitchen renovations, optimizing space and style.
reformas-de-interiores.description: We are experts in renovating bathrooms and kitchens, two of the most important rooms in the home. We optimize the distribution to gain functionality and create modern and cozy environments using state-of-the-art materials.
features: Complete renewal of tiling and flooring.
Installation of new plumbing and electricity.
Custom assembly of kitchen and bathroom furniture.
Installation of shower trays, screens, and sanitary ware.

alicatados-pavimentos.title: Tiling & Flooring Renewal
alicatados-pavimentos.description: Replacement of ceramic coatings, microcement, and wooden floors to modernize the aesthetics of your rooms.
alicatados-pavimentos.answer: Replacing tiling or flooring in Mallorca costs €45 to €110 per m² including materials. Large-format porcelain and microcement sit at the top of the range because of the labour they demand. Removing the old surface adds €12 to €20 per m².

instalaciones-fontaneria-electricidad.title: Technical Installations
instalaciones-fontaneria-electricidad.description: Complete renovation of plumbing networks and electrical circuits to meet regulations and improve safety.
instalaciones-fontaneria-electricidad.answer: Fully renewing plumbing and electrics in Mallorca costs €90 to €180 per m² of property. It covers a new consumer unit, wiring, switchgear, multilayer pipework, drainage and the official certificate. For a 90 m² home that is €8,100 to €16,200.

mobiliario-medida.title: Custom Furniture
mobiliario-medida.description: Design and assembly of kitchen and bathroom furniture that takes advantage of every available centimeter.
mobiliario-medida.answer: Bespoke kitchen furniture in Mallorca costs €650 to €1,900 per linear metre depending on fronts, hardware and worktop. Made-to-measure wardrobes and dressing rooms run €400 to €900 per m² of frontage. Design and installation are always included.

banos-sanitarios.title: Bathroom Equipment
banos-sanitarios.description: Expert installation of ultra-flat shower trays, glass screens, and designer suspended sanitary ware.
banos-sanitarios.answer: A full bathroom renovation in Mallorca costs €4,500 to €12,000 depending on size and finishes. It covers demolition, plumbing, tiling, flooring, shower tray, screen, sanitaryware, vanity unit and taps. A standard 5 m² bathroom typically lands around €7,000.

paramentos-verticales.title: Vertical Walls
paramentos-verticales.subtitle: We protect and beautify your facades and walls.
paramentos-verticales.shortDescription: Solutions for facades and walls, from cladding to insulation.
paramentos-verticales.description: We offer a wide range of solutions for vertical walls, including the application of single-layer mortars, renders, and external thermal insulation systems (ETICS), improving the energy efficiency and aesthetics of your building.
features: Application of continuous coatings.
External Thermal Insulation Composite Systems (ETICS).
Repair and rehabilitation of facades.
Exterior painting and waterproofing.

revestimientos-continuos.title: Continuous Coatings
revestimientos-continuos.description: Application of technical and decorative mortars to protect and beautify exterior walls.
revestimientos-continuos.answer: A continuous render finish in Mallorca costs €35 to €75 per m², excluding scaffolding. Single-coat mortar sits at the low end, lime and polished stucco finishes at the high end. Scaffolding adds €8 to €15 per m² of façade.

aislamiento-sate.title: ETICS Insulation
aislamiento-sate.description: External Thermal Insulation Composite System to drastically reduce your home's energy consumption.
aislamiento-sate.answer: External wall insulation (ETICS) in Mallorca costs €90 to €140 per m² of façade, including scaffolding, insulation, mesh, renders and finish. On a detached house with 180 m² of façade that is €16,000 to €25,000. It cuts heating and cooling demand by 30-50%.

rehabilitacion-fachadas.title: Facade Rehabilitation
rehabilitacion-fachadas.description: Aesthetic and functional recovery of deteriorated facades, ensuring safety and revaluing the property.
rehabilitacion-fachadas.answer: Façade refurbishment in Mallorca costs €60 to €130 per m² depending on the level of decay. It covers chipping out hollow areas, treating exposed rebar, repairing cornices, rendering and painting. Listed façades or stone elements need individual assessment.

pintura-impermeabilizacion-exterior.title: Exterior Painting & Waterproofing
pintura-impermeabilizacion-exterior.description: Water-repellent treatments and high-resistance paints for durable protection against the weather.
pintura-impermeabilizacion-exterior.answer: Painting and waterproofing a façade in Mallorca costs €18 to €40 per m². Mineral paint sits at the low end, elastomeric coatings with bonding primer at the high end. Coastal locations warrant the elastomeric option: salt and sea humidity shorten service life considerably.

electricidad.title: Electricity
electricidad.subtitle: Safe and efficient electrical installations for your peace of mind.
electricidad.shortDescription: Wiring, lighting, panel upgrades, and safety inspections.
electricidad.description: We carry out all types of electrical installations, from the complete wiring of a home to the installation of new light points, always complying with current regulations to ensure maximum safety and energy efficiency.
features: Complete electrical installations in new construction.
Updating and reforming old installations.
Electrical bulletins and certifications.
Installation of low-consumption LED lighting.

instalaciones-obra-nueva.title: New Build Electrical Installations
instalaciones-obra-nueva.description: Design and execution of comprehensive electrical projects for new homes and buildings.
instalaciones-obra-nueva.answer: Wiring a new-build home in Mallorca costs €55 to €95 per m². It covers the consumer unit, cabling, switchgear, lighting points, sockets and the official certificate for the utility connection. Basic home automation adds €15 to €30 per m².

actualizacion-reforma-electrica.title: Electrical Upgrade & Reform
actualizacion-reforma-electrica.description: Replacement of old wiring and electrical panels to adapt the installation to current regulations.
actualizacion-reforma-electrica.answer: Upgrading a home's electrical installation in Mallorca costs €3,500 to €9,000. It covers a new consumer unit with RCDs and breakers, rewiring, switchgear and certification. It is mandatory if the installation predates 1973 or has no earthing.

boletines-certificaciones.title: Bulletins & Certifications
boletines-certificaciones.description: Issuance of official electrical bulletins and management with supply companies.
boletines-certificaciones.answer: An official electrical certificate in Mallorca costs €150 to €450 depending on contracted power and use. It covers inspection, measurements, issuance by an authorised installer and registration with the regional authority. It is required to connect or upgrade supply.

iluminacion-led.title: Efficient LED Lighting
iluminacion-led.description: Technical and decorative lighting projects with LED technology for maximum savings and visual comfort.
iluminacion-led.answer: An LED lighting project in Mallorca costs €25 to €70 per installed light point, materials included. A full swap in a home cuts lighting consumption by 60-80%, with payback typically between 18 and 30 months.

carpinteria.title: Wood and Aluminum Carpentry
carpinteria.subtitle: Artisanal precision and modern durability in your finishes.
carpinteria.shortDescription: Expert services in wood and aluminum carpentry for a perfect and long-lasting finish.
carpinteria.description: We combine the warmth of traditional wood carpentry with the modernity and resilience of aluminum carpentry. We offer custom solutions for doors, windows, enclosures, pergolas, and furniture, adapting to the aesthetics and functionality of your project. Whether you're looking for a classic touch or a contemporary design, our team masterfully works with both materials.
features: Manufacturing and installation of aluminum and PVC windows and doors with thermal break.
Design and assembly of aluminum enclosures, pergolas, and structures.
Installation of wooden passage and entrance doors.
Design and manufacturing of custom wooden wardrobes, dressing rooms, and furniture.

ventanas-puertas-aluminio-pvc.title: Aluminum/PVC Windows & Doors
ventanas-puertas-aluminio-pvc.description: High energy efficiency exterior carpentry with thermal break and double glazing.
ventanas-puertas-aluminio-pvc.answer: Replacing windows in Mallorca costs €450 to €950 per m² of opening depending on material and performance. uPVC with double glazing sits at the low end; thermally broken aluminium with triple glazing at the high end. Removal, installation and trims are included.

cerramientos-pergolas.title: Enclosures & Pergolas
cerramientos-pergolas.description: Lightweight structures for terraces and gardens, extending your living space to the outside.
cerramientos-pergolas.answer: A pergola or terrace enclosure in Mallorca costs €300 to €850 per m². Aluminium pergolas with adjustable louvres sit at the high end; fixed structures with lightweight roofing at the low end. Check first whether the work needs municipal planning permission.

puertas-paso-entrada.title: Passage & Entrance Doors
puertas-paso-entrada.description: Supply and installation of solid, lacquered, or armored wooden doors with premium finishes.
puertas-paso-entrada.answer: An internal door installed in Mallorca costs €220 to €900 depending on material and finish. White lacquered doors sit at the low end; solid timber or pocket sliders at the high end. A reinforced or armoured entrance door runs €900 to €2,500.

armarios-vestidores-medida.title: Custom Wardrobes & Walk-in Closets
armarios-vestidores-medida.description: Design of personalized wardrobe interiors for maximum organization and elegance.
armarios-vestidores-medida.answer: A fitted wardrobe in Mallorca costs €400 to €900 per m² of frontage. Price depends on the opening system, hardware and internal organisation. A full 6 m² dressing room typically lands between €3,500 and €6,500.

fontaneria.title: Specialized Plumbing
fontaneria.subtitle: Durable solutions for the water system of your home or business.
fontaneria.shortDescription: Complete plumbing services, from installations to repairs.
fontaneria.description: Our qualified plumbers take care of the installation and repair of the entire sanitation and drinking water network. We guarantee fast, clean, and durable work, using the best quality materials.
features: Complete installation of plumbing and drainage networks.
Repair of leaks and breakdowns.
Installation of faucets and sanitary ware.
Domestic hot water systems (boilers, heaters).

redes-fontaneria-desagues.title: Plumbing & Drainage Networks
redes-fontaneria-desagues.description: Installation of supply and evacuation pipes with modern materials (multilayer, PPR, soundproof PVC).
redes-fontaneria-desagues.answer: Renewing plumbing and drainage in Mallorca costs €45 to €90 per m² of property. It covers multilayer or PPR pipework, isolation valves per room, acoustic PVC drainage and pressure testing. For a 90 m² home that is €4,000 to €8,100.

reparacion-fugas.title: Leak Repair & Breakdowns
reparacion-fugas.description: Quick detection and definitive solution of tightness problems and blockages.
reparacion-fugas.answer: Repairing a water leak in Mallorca costs €120 to €600 depending on where it is and how accessible. Non-destructive detection with acoustic or thermal imaging equipment is billed at €120 to €250, and that amount is deducted if we carry out the repair.

griferia-sanitarios.title: Faucets & Sanitary Ware Installation
griferia-sanitarios.description: Assembly of bathroom and kitchen elements of all brands, ensuring perfect operation.
griferia-sanitarios.answer: Installing taps or sanitaryware in Mallorca costs €90 to €250 per fixture, excluding materials. A wall-hung WC with concealed frame rises to €350-€550 because of the building work involved. A straight tap swap sits at the low end.

agua-caliente-sanitaria.title: Domestic Hot Water
agua-caliente-sanitaria.description: Installation and maintenance of electric water heaters, gas heaters, and aerothermal systems.
agua-caliente-sanitaria.answer: Domestic hot water in Mallorca costs from €450 for an electric cylinder to €6,500 for an aerothermal system. A gas water heater sits between €700 and €1,400. Aerothermal is the most efficient option and performs best in the Balearic climate.

pintura.title: Professional Painting
pintura.subtitle: We bring color and new life to your walls, inside and out.
pintura.shortDescription: Interior and exterior painting services for homes, communities, and commercial spaces.
pintura.description: Our team of professional painters transforms any space with a flawless finish. We use high-quality paints to ensure durability and a superior aesthetic result, whether it's for renovating a room or protecting your building's facade.
features: Plastic, enamel, and decorative paints for interiors.
Special coatings and paints for exterior facades.
Wall smoothing and stipple removal.
Moisture treatment and surface preparation.

pintura-interior-decorativa.title: Interior & Decorative Painting
pintura-interior-decorativa.description: Smooth finishes, stucco, wallpaper, and decorative techniques to customize your environments.
pintura-interior-decorativa.answer: Painting a home interior in Mallorca costs €8 to €25 per m² of painted surface. Flat white emulsion sits at the low end; stucco, glazes and wallpaper at the high end. A 90 m² property usually lands between €1,400 and €3,200.

pintura-fachadas.title: Facade Painting
pintura-fachadas.description: Elastic and stone coatings to protect the building envelope against the weather.
pintura-fachadas.answer: Painting a façade in Mallorca costs €14 to €32 per m², excluding scaffolding. It covers cleaning, crack sealing, primer and two finish coats. Coastal locations warrant elastomeric paint with salt protection: it sits at the high end but doubles service life.

alisado-paredes.title: Wall Smoothing & Stipple Removal
alisado-paredes.description: Transformation of old walls into smooth and modern surfaces, ready to paint or wallpaper.
alisado-paredes.answer: Removing textured 'gotelé' and skimming walls in Mallorca costs €12 to €22 per m², finish paint included. The process is filling, sanding, priming and two coats. It is the single intervention that transforms an older property most for the money.

tratamiento-humedades.title: Moisture Treatment
tratamiento-humedades.description: Sanitation of surfaces affected by mold, saltpeter, or capillarity before painting.
tratamiento-humedades.answer: Treating damp in Mallorca costs €35 to €120 per m² of affected surface depending on the cause. Surface condensation sits at the low end; rising damp, which needs a chemical barrier or injection, at the high end. The cause must be fixed before painting.

impermeabilizacion.title: Waterproofing and Roofing
impermeabilizacion.subtitle: Total protection against leaks and humidity.
impermeabilizacion.shortDescription: Expert solutions for roofs, and terraces, ensuring complete watertightness.
impermeabilizacion.description: Proper waterproofing is key to the health of any building. We offer comprehensive solutions for flat roofs, terraces, pitched roofs, and walls, using the most advanced systems to prevent and definitively solve problems of leaks and humidity.
features: Waterproofing of flat roofs and walkable terraces.
Repair and maintenance of roofs.
Application of asphalt sheets, PVC, EPDM, and liquid membranes.
Thermal insulation for roofs, improving energy efficiency.

cubiertas-planas-terrazas.title: Flat Roofs & Terraces
cubiertas-planas-terrazas.description: Walkable waterproofing with finishes in tile, gravel, or artificial grass.
cubiertas-planas-terrazas.answer: Waterproofing a flat roof or terrace in Mallorca costs €55 to €120 per m². It covers removing the existing surface, forming falls, membrane, insulation and a trafficable finish. Keeping the current surface with a liquid membrane brings it down to €30-€50 per m².

reparacion-tejados.title: Roof Repair
reparacion-tejados.description: Replacement of broken tiles, gutter cleaning, and reinforcement of singular points on pitched roofs.
reparacion-tejados.answer: Repairing a pitched roof in Mallorca costs €40 to €95 per m² depending on scope. Spot tile replacement and valley repairs sit at the low end; full stripping with new battens and underlay at the high end. Gutter cleaning is included.

laminas-membranas.title: Technical Sheets & Membranes
laminas-membranas.description: Certified installation of EPDM, PVC sheets, and latest generation asphalt fabrics.
laminas-membranas.answer: Installing a waterproofing membrane in Mallorca costs €45 to €85 per m² depending on the system. EPDM and reinforced PVC allow large sheets with fewer welds, which reduces weak points. Every installation we complete is handed over with a flood test.

aislamiento-cubiertas.title: Roof Thermal Insulation
aislamiento-cubiertas.description: Incorporation of insulating panels under the waterproofing to improve thermal comfort under the roof.
aislamiento-cubiertas.answer: Adding thermal insulation beneath a roof's waterproofing in Mallorca costs €30 to €60 per m² extra. It is the best-returning upgrade in the whole building envelope: the roof accounts for up to 30% of a home's heat loss and gain.

cta.title: Ready to start your {serviceName} project?
cta.subtitle: Get a cost estimate for your project right now. It's fast and non-binding.

steps.title: 1. Initial Consultation
steps.description: We evaluate your needs and the current state to define the scope.

steps.title: 2. Planning
steps.description: We design the technical solution and present a detailed budget.

steps.title: 3. Expert Execution
steps.description: We carry out the work meeting deadlines and with top quality materials.

steps.title: 4. Delivery & Warranty
steps.description: Joint final review and delivery of documentation and guarantees.

items.question: Do you offer a warranty for the work performed?
items.answer: Yes, all our services come with a full warranty on both labor and materials, in accordance with current regulations and our quality standards.

items.question: Does the budget include license management?
items.answer: We can manage all the necessary municipal licenses and permits for your work or renovation, so you don't have to worry about the paperwork.

items.question: How long does it take to start the work?
items.answer: Our response capacity is fast. Once the budget is approved, we agree on an immediate start date according to availability and project complexity.
